prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Houston, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1178; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim documentation. Can you please state your full name for the record?

A: I'd prefer to leave my name off the recording, if that's all right. I can tell you what happened.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision took place?

A: It was in a parking lot in Houston, Texas, at a shopping center. I was pulling out of a parking space near the main entrance when another vehicle came down the drive lane.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I had checked my mirror and was backing out slowly. I'd just started to roll when the other car struck the rear passenger side of my vehicle. It wasn't a high-speed impact, but it was enough to jolt me forward and to the side.

Q: Did you notice whether the other driver had their headlights or brake lights on?

A: I'm not certain. I remember the car was moving at a fairly steady pace, and I didn't see it stop before it hit me.

Q: Where did you feel the injury?

A: My right knee hit the steering column and the dashboard area. It swelled up within a few hours, and I've had trouble bending it and putting weight on it since.

Q: Have you seen a medical provider about the knee?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same day and I've been going to physical therapy since. The doctor has ordered more imaging, and I'm still waiting on those results.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'd like the claim handled as quickly as possible, since I'm missing work and still getting around with difficulty.

Q: Understood. Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the recorded statement.
